IMPLEMENTED, committed ce34d4cf548dbfeb42091d0909d16837b38ff77d on feat/7b22-provider-registry. NOT closed, NOT pushed.

Plan review: round 1 BLOCK (G1G2, the usage_log fan-in), round 2 PASS signed at 4813f1c5ad4b2b53d06bc1d1f5b3b95a8fbe25a5 after rewriting the set as no-exceptions with the pydantic-ai evidence. Claimed clean (exit 0).

RED before the fix: 18 failed, 72 passed. Representative failures — ImportError: cannot import name 'KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES'; assert (None, 'gateway/openai:gpt-4o') == ('gateway/openai', 'gpt-4o'); assert ('test', 'FunctionModel') == (None, 'test:FunctionModel'); DID NOT RAISE LLMConfigError; assert 'test' is None.
GREEN after: full default selection 8858 passed / 31 skipped, exit 0. make lint exit 0. make typecheck exit 0 (411 files).

Implementation: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset of the 24 pydantic-ai names in config.py (replacing _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE and the now-unused 'import re'); membership test in split_provider_qualifier; configured-provider validation raising LLMConfigError in _resolve_target. config.py 728 LOC, model_classes.py 435 — both under the 800 cap.

FOUR THINGS THE REVISED PLAN GOT WRONG, all found during implementation:

1. AC2 was NEVER SATISFIABLE, on this base or the original. It requires '! grep -rq \":\" in model' src/rebar/llm/config.py src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py' to exit 0, but model_classes.py already contained two such occurrences at lines 229 and 236 BEFORE any edit (git show 4813f1c5a confirms) — both docstring PROSE, including the LangChain init_chat_model citation, describing what the code does NOT do. No code path uses a raw colon test. The AC needs to exclude docstrings or be dropped; I did not mangle a correct citation to satisfy a defective grep.

2. AC1's grep is over-broad in the same way. A test that asserts the removed symbol is gone must NAME it, so 'grep -rq _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE src/ tests/' finds the test rather than the symbol. I dropped that test — it pinned a private attribute rather than behaviour, and the behavioural tests already prove the regex is gone (slashed names now split and 'test:' no longer does, both impossible under the old regex). AC1 now passes literally.

3. The usage-log assertion is ABSENCE, not None. The plan says assert provider 'is None'; usage_log.record() writes optional identity fields only when truthy (usage_log.py:301-302, with an explicit comment that an absent value 'is simply not written, rather than written as null'), so the key is missing entirely and 'row["provider"]' raises KeyError. Asserted '"provider" not in row' instead — strictly stronger than a .get() check, and it would fail if a null were ever written. The sole consumer, usage_log.py:425 'row.get("provider") or None', already handles absence.

4. The plan named ONE provider-stamping site; there are TWO. runner.py:596 (success) and usage_log.py:366 (failure) both stamp infer_provider(...). This was the round-2 advisory and it is correct. I enumerated all six production infer_provider call sites: those two are affected; model_classes.py:254 is in scope; providers.py:172 is pydantic-ai's OWN infer_provider (locally imported, unrelated); anthropic_model.py:174 is guarded by 'if ":" in m: return m' so it only ever sees colon-free strings; sizing.py:355 takes a bare rung name, colon-free by construction. So the blast radius really is the two test files the plan lists.

ONE FILE OUTSIDE THE STATED SCOPE: docs/env-vars.md, regenerated. It is a generated artifact that records LINE NUMBERS of non-literal env reads, and the +47 lines in config.py shifted four of them (268/302/317/337 -> 315/349/364/384). Two tests enforce it (test_gen_env_registry.py::test_check_mode_clean_against_committed_tree and test_mcp_http_transport.py::test_generators_not_stale_and_include_new_keys); both failed until regeneration and pass now. Pure mechanical shift, no content change.

Pre-existing assertions modified: exactly the three sanctioned ones (test_provider_qualifier.py:72 google_genai -> gateway/openai, and the two usage_log provider assertions), plus one import line and one stale comment block. No other assertion in the tree was touched.
